object_description: three-storey lightweight volume over a solid gymnasium base
design_condition: The large volume is set into the wooded slope, with its narrow side toward the schoolyard and its long side defining the street, while a wide landscape staircase and planted open spaces connect the two levels.

positive.statement: The placement of the large volume creates a site-specific solution of great spatial quality and clarifies the street conditions.

position.rationale: The large rectangular volume and long street-defining edge are clearly visible across all projections.

positive.statement: The carefully elaborated open-space concept offers a variety of outdoor spaces and pleasant places to spend time in hotter summers.

position.rationale: Multiple planted and open areas visibly surround the large embedded building.

positive.statement: The clear structural concept, spacious assembly hall, atrium, and material combination result in user-friendly interior spaces with architectural quality.

position.target: assembly hall, atrium, and material combination
position.rationale: The central atrium is visibly indicated in plan; interior hall and materials are anchored nearby.

positive.statement: The existing high-quality buildings can accommodate new forms of teaching through proportionate interventions in the fabric.

position.target: existing buildings and new forms of teaching
position.rationale: The intervention is anchored at the lower-side relationship between the main volume and surrounding site.

negative.statement: The upper classroom half appears open and light but has hardly any recognizable reference to the site.

position.rationale: The lightweight upper half is clearly separated above the solid base in the elevations.

negative.statement: The choice of a block with an inner courtyard is hardly understandable on the outskirts of the town.

position.rationale: The rectangular perimeter and central opening are visible in plan and corresponding elevations.

negative.statement: The dining rooms are constricted by the adjoining room layer and are only just sufficiently accessible.

position.rationale: Dining rooms are approximated within the long upper-volume interior edge.

negative.statement: The kitchen and childcare area is constricted by the structure.

position.rationale: The service and childcare zone is approximated along the opposite side of the upper volume.

negative.statement: The assembly hall only keeps its spatial promise when the folding walls are open; otherwise it changes from open to labyrinthine and from light to dark.

position.rationale: The hall is anchored near the solid base and central interior organization, though not externally distinguishable.

negative.statement: The classroom size and group-room layout do not meet the operational requirements.

position.rationale: The upper classroom floor provides the constrained spatial anchor for the stated planning criticism.
